Mission Statement
Our mission is to offer an internationally competitive doctoral training, combining excellent research and teaching. The Doctoral School of Ecology and Evolution provides PhD candidates an excellent research environment and infrastructure to carry out cutting edge research and to advance our knowledge on the organization and development of individual organisms to ecosystems.
Doctoral programme
Find out how the doctoral programme is structured, including admission requirements, supervision, and training opportunities throughout your PhD.
Join the DocSchool
Learn how to become part of the VDSEE, including application to the School, requirements, and what to expect during your PhD journey.
Research Areas
Get an overview of the research fields within the VDSEE and explore the topics and approaches represented.
Activities & Events
Discover seminars, workshops, and events available to members of the doctoral school, supporting exchange, networking, and professional development.
VDSEE Symposium 2027
The 4th annual VDSEE Symposium will take place on 19 February 2027: Members of our Doctoral School will be sharing their latest research achievements with their peers and researchers from Ecology and Evolution.
Join us for an engaging program of talks and poster presentations by PhD candidates of the VDSEE and two keynotes by Marja Spierenburg (Universiteit Leiden) and Ronny Lauerwald (University of Paris-Saclay).
The best talks and posters will be awarded!
In the evening before the Symposium, on 18 February 2027, we're hosting an Arts&Science event at WUK.
Register now
Open position in Marine Microbial Ecology
We are happy to share a new fully funded PhD position within the international research project VERA (Variability of Ecologically Relevant Bacterioneuston), studying the activity and genomic adaptation of bacteria in the sea-surface microlayer of the Atlantic Ocean.
Application deadline: 20th November 2026
Mailing list
The VDSEE posts new openings several times a year.
If you wish to be informed you can join our openings mailing list.
